shrine_travel.doc: The save shrines' travel list (ShrineTravelMenu; SPEC 6.6, ShrineNetwork; docs/kb/tech/ui.md section Shrine travel). Rects x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference, multiples of 3; centred like the battle pause. max_rows sizes the list (destinations plus Stay here; a longer network scrolls in the MenuPage). dim_alpha darkens the field under the page in the theme's panel_low.
